name: mirage
text: First finding: SharpAPI holds ~60,000 NFL rows but only 118 lines from ONE book came out of them (every league is the same, 1 book each), so the conversion is throwing most rows away. Not a team-name mapping problem yet; the rows aren't getting as far as matching. I'm adding a per-league breakdown of why rows are dropped and will ship it now so the next scan tells me exactly which rule it is. Second finding: the Novig stream is only holding ~500 of the 2,000 markets asked for, because the engine never read the key's /v3/limits and runs on the default allowance; I'll fix that next.
